title: Submission Training (F4A (Partner))
description: You belong to them. Not just in name, not just in fantasy—but in the deepest, most undeniable sense : you are owned. Fully. Proudly. Willingly. Every word I speak will reinforce your purpose—your role as theirs. Your mind, your body, your service... all offered without hesitation. You’ll crave their voice, obey their commands, and give everything for their pleasure. You’ll learn that true freedom isn’t found in control—it’s found in surrender. You’ll feel proud of your submission. Because when you serve them, when you kneel for them, when you obey without question… you are exactly what you were meant to be. This isn’t just obedience—it’s devotion. This isn’t play—it’s truth. They own you. And you want that more than anything. Let me guide you into becoming theirs—completely, endlessly, beautifully.
author: Mistress Shibby
